text: Three pull requests change behaviour in ways that can break callers. #14281 stops item journal code from treating ordinary lines and templates as manufacturing records when Manufacturing subscribers are absent, using new Boolean predicate events that default to false, in all country layers. #14002 makes External File Storage reject path segments that are "." or "..", so callers passing relative segments now get an error. #13012 lets the Subcontracting worksheet assign suggestions to existing open purchase orders. Other subcontracting work adds a summary factbox on the Released Production Order Card (#14111) and fixes undo of the final operation (#14138) and a transfer order page refresh (#14122). Costing and manufacturing fixes cover a BigInteger overflow in Item Application Entry (#14332) and reversed production output (#14080, #13669). Prepayment amounts no longer drift on orders after partial posting (#14283 for sales and purchase, #13503 for sales). Expense Agent gets a no-receipt flow (#12544) and approval fixes (#13978, #13992). Sales Lines Suggestions and No. Series Copilot move to GPT-5.6 Ceres (#14307, #14198, #14059), while #14007 obsoletes Create Product Information with Copilot. Localisation covers SAF-T 1.40 for Norway (#13264), Czech exchange gain/loss posting (#13631), German VAT Report fields (#13807, #14133) and GST application fixes (#14008, #14009). #11715 adds approval for Fixed Asset Journals, and #13999 and #14329 are performance changes.

issues: #14009 is described as GST posting order, but it avoids an empty GST component lookup error when customer payments are reapplied. Only #14008 fixes the posting sequence.
#13503 changes only the Sales Line table, not sales and purchase lines. Prepayment was also listed under costing and manufacturing fixes, so it now has its own sentence.
